name: @shibbirweb/mcp-db-read-only

tools.name: current_connection
tools.description: Show which database server, engine and database the read-only tools are currently pointed at

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connection profiles available to switch to, with each one's engine, including any added during this session

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List databases on the currently connected server (schemas on MySQL, numbered databases on Redis)

include_system.description: Include system databases such as information_schema, pg templates, or MongoDB admin and local

tools.name: use_database
tools.description: Switch the active database on the current server. Takes effect immediately, no restart needed

database.description: Database name to switch to, or the database number on Redis

tools.name: use_connection
tools.description: Switch to a named connection profile, on any engine. Takes effect immediately, no restart needed

database.description: Optional database to use instead of the profile's own database

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect to a database at runtime with a connection URL (mysql, mariadb, postgres, sqlite, mssql, clickhouse, mongodb, redis, elasticsearch, opensearch). Not persisted to disk, but kept for the rest of the session under an alias

url.description: Connection URL, e.g. postgres://user@host:5432/db, mongodb://user@host/db, redis://host:6379/0, sqlite:///path/to/file.db. Use host.docker.internal for a database on this machine when running in Docker

password.description: Password, if not in the URL. Avoids percent-encoding special characters

alias.description: Name to remember this connection under for use_connection later

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List the tables in the active database: collections on MongoDB, keys on Redis, indices on Elasticsearch

pattern.description: Optional glob filter, * for any characters and ? for one, e.g. user* or logs-2026-*

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Show the structure of a table: columns on SQL engines, inferred fields for a MongoDB collection, the mapping of an Elasticsearch index, or the type and TTL of a Redis key

table.description: Table name (schema.table where the engine has schemas), collection, Redis key, or index

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: get_table_indexes
tools.description: Show indexes on a table or MongoDB collection, or the sorting key and skipping indices of a ClickHouse table

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: get_foreign_keys
tools.description: Show foreign key relationships for a table on MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite or SQL Server

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: get_table_sample
tools.description: Get sample rows from a table, documents from a collection, hits from an index, or the first entries of a Redis key

table.description: Table, collection, index, or Redis key

limit.description: Number of rows to return (1-50, default 5)

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query (SELECT, WITH, and the engine's SHOW, DESCRIBE or EXPLAIN) on a MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server or ClickHouse connection

query.description: SQL query to execute, in the active engine's dialect

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: find_documents
tools.description: Find documents in a MongoDB collection with a filter, optional projection and sort

filter.description: Query filter as MongoDB Extended JSON, e.g. {"status": "active", "_id": {"$oid": "..."}}

projection.description: Fields to include or exclude, e.g. {"name": 1, "_id": 0}

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: aggregate
tools.description: Run a read-only MongoDB aggregation pipeline on a collection ($out and $merge are not allowed)

pipeline.description: Pipeline stages as Extended JSON, e.g. [{"$match": {"status": "active"}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$type", "n": {"$sum": 1}}}]

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: count_documents
tools.description: Count documents in a MongoDB collection that match a filter

filter.description: Query filter as MongoDB Extended JSON, e.g. {"status": "active", "_id": {"$oid": "..."}}

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: distinct_values
tools.description: List the distinct values of a field in a MongoDB collection, optionally within a filter

field.description: Field path, e.g. status or address.city

filter.description: Query filter as MongoDB Extended JSON, e.g. {"status": "active", "_id": {"$oid": "..."}}

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search an Elasticsearch or OpenSearch index with a Query DSL body. Use size 0 with track_total_hits true to count, and aggs for aggregations

index.description: Index name, pattern such as logs-*, or comma-separated list

tools.name: redis_command
tools.description: Run one read-only Redis command such as GET, HGETALL, LRANGE, ZRANGE, SCAN, TTL or INFO. Write commands and KEYS are refused

database.description: Optional database to read from for this call only, without changing the active connection
